title: Cordoba with Seville Moving (Paco)
text: We had a wonderful experience visiting Cordoba with Seville Moving. Cordoba is both beautiful and historic with attractions in equal amounts for history buffs, foodies, adventurers or photography enthusiasts. Our driver and guide Paco (Francisco) was equally a reason why the trip was so great. Paco made every effort to make sure we were comfortable during the tour, he guided us through the city and all the main attractions and answered all our questions about the history of the place. He gave us ample time to enjoy every bit the city had to offer,and made sure we found a place for a great meal
author: Prasenjit_G

title: Successful journey
text:
